help: [DEVELOPMENT TOOL] assigns salvage specials to entities
spawns a station of <type> at your location
removes disruption from all industries on a market
spawns ruins if procGen failed again
displays a list of the current star system timeouts
displays a summary of mod data and classes
sets market growth to the given number, example: 0.43 for 43%
spawns rogue asteroids aimed at your course, shapes: scatter, cluster, teardrop, wall, chevron, pair, escort, or starts a drizzle
spawns fog in your current star system, a whole system spell by default or a local bank, ambush forces lurker fleets, cache hides a cache in a bank

syntax: indevo_pet list | give <species> [name] | age <pet> <days> | hearts <pet> <0-5> | want <pet> <want> | trait <pet> <trait> <grade> | scan <pet> | title <pet> <title>
help: lists your pets, gives you a pet on a free ship or in the menagerie, ages a pet by days, sets its hearts, opens a want (attention, play, treat, comfort, shore_leave, come_along) and stars the pet, sets a trait grade (0 removes it) and reads it, reads every trait like a gene scan, or gives a title (veteran, navigator, old_timer, survivor, beloved, pampered, treasure_hunter, admiral, globetrotter, stargazer; clear removes all)
